reviews.text:
I bought this product after seeing so many positive reviews and decided to try the mini size first.

Unfortunately, it doesn’t seem to have the best staying power on my skin. The finish can feel a little heavy if I apply too much, so I find that it works better when applied in thin layers and built up gradually.

I’m still testing different application methods, but I think using a small amount and layering slowly gives the most natural-looking result.
reviews.zh:
睇到好多好評之後買咗呢個產品，決定先試吓細裝。

可惜嘅係，佢喺我皮膚上嘅持久力似乎唔算最好。如果搽太多，妝效會覺得有少少厚重，所以我發現薄薄咁一層一層慢慢疊上去效果會好啲。

我仲喺度試緊唔同嘅上妝方法，但我覺得用少量、再慢慢疊，係最自然嘅效果。

reviews.text: This is the best cushion I've bought. I tend to stray away from cushion foundations because they cake up a bit to much for my liking. However!! This cushion is so good!! I didn't set it with powder, and it looks so dewy. Like my skin but elevated. I put a very light layer in the photo because I prefer very light makeup. I can easily layer more and get a very full coverage look. The color is also great. I bought the mini because I wanted to try out the color and cushion before buying the full size. I will definitely buy the full size of this!
reviews.zh: 呢個係我買過最好嘅氣墊。我一向都唔太鍾意氣墊粉底，因為對我嚟講佢哋通常都會有啲厚粉感。但係！！呢個氣墊真係超正！！我冇用碎粉定妝，妝感好水光，好似我嘅皮膚不過升咗級。我相入面只係搽咗好薄一層，因為我鍾意超薄妝感。我可以輕易疊加多幾層做到好高遮瑕嘅妝效。顏色都好好。買細裝係因為我想試吓顏色同氣墊先再買大裝。我一定會回購大裝！

reviews.text:
I got the TIRTIR Mask Fit Red Mini Cushion in the shade 29N Natural Beige, and while the shade wasn’t a perfect match, that’s exactly why I opted for the mini version—to test it out without committing to a full-sized product. It’s super convenient if you’re shopping online and don’t want to risk buying the wrong shade.

The cushion itself is really good—great coverage that hides dark circles and post-acne marks like a pro. However, because of its higher coverage, it does feel a bit heavy on the skin. Another downside is that it oxidizes fairly quickly—within two hours, it looked darker on me compared to my usual Armani foundation.

That said, I’m planning to try the 28N Oat shade for a better match. It’s perfect to keep in my bag for quick touch-ups when I’m on the go. Unless I find a budget-friendly cushion that’s lighter and doesn’t oxidize, this one’s definitely staying in my rotation!
reviews.zh:
我買咗 TIRTIR Mask Fit Red 細裝氣墊嘅 29N Natural Beige 色號，雖然色號唔係完全啱我，但呢個正正係我揀細裝嘅原因——可以試吓先，唔使一開始就買大裝。如果係網購，唔想冒險買錯色，細裝真係超方便。

氣墊本身真係唔錯——遮瑕力強，黑眼圈同暗瘡印都輕鬆遮住。不過因為遮瑕力高，喺皮膚上會覺得有少少厚。另一個缺點係佢氧化得好快——兩個鐘之內，喺我塊面已經比起我平時用嘅 Armani 粉底顯深。

不過，我打算試吓 28N Oat 呢個色號睇吓會唔會啱啲。帶出街放喺袋入面補妝真係一流。除非我搵到一支價錢親民、輕薄啲又唔會氧化嘅氣墊，否則呢支一定會留喺我嘅輪換名單入面！

reviews.text:
I bought the 17C tone and I think it's pretty close to my natural color. Even though it's a cool tone, I still see a kind of warm undertone. In the pictures I took, I only put the foundation under my eyes and near my mouth. I don't have on my forehead and my chin.

Also I didn't use any concealer or powder before&after using it. It doesn't make you look glowy. It really covered my dark circles (that's why I share with you all my bare face so you can see the difference hahaha). And I didn't really need to use a lot of the content. But if you don't use powder, if you touch your face you can feel it a bit sticky.

I took pictures on natural and artificial lights, so you can see how different it looks on different lights.

Maybe next time I'll try the 17W or 17N so I can get the perfect tone.

Overall it's good and lasts for a really long time.
reviews.zh:
我買咗 17C 色號，我覺得同我本身膚色好接近。雖然係冷調，但我都仲睇到有少少暖底調。喺我影嘅相入面，我只喺眼底同近嘴邊位搽咗粉底，額頭同下巴都冇搽。

而且用之前同用之後我都冇用任何遮瑕或者碎粉。佢唔會令你望落好有水光感。佢真係遮到我嘅黑眼圈（所以我特登素顏 share 畀大家睇，可以見到分別哈哈哈）。我都唔需要用好多份量。但係如果你唔用碎粉，摸到塊面會覺得有少少黏。

我喺自然光同埋人造光底下都影咗相，等大家可以睇到唔同光底下嘅分別。

可能下次我會試吓 17W 或者 17N，希望可以搵到最啱嘅色號。

整體嚟講佢唔錯，而且持久度好高。

reviews.text: I recently tried the TIRTIR Mini Cushion, and I’m so impressed with its high coverage! Despite being lightweight, it does an amazing job of covering blemishes and evening out my skin tone without feeling cakey. The cushion leaves a natural, semi-matte finish that lasts throughout the day, and the compact size makes it super convenient for touch-ups on the go. I also love how it doesn’t dry out my skin. If you’re looking for a high-coverage cushion that feels light and looks flawless, this is a great choice!
reviews.zh: 我最近試咗 TIRTIR 細裝氣墊，佢嘅高遮瑕力真係令我好驚喜！雖然質地輕，但遮瑕效果好出色，可以遮住瑕疵、均勻膚色之餘又唔會有厚粉感。氣墊上妝之後呈現自然嘅半霧面妝效，全日都 keep 到，細細個好方便帶出街補妝。我都好鍾意佢唔會抽乾皮膚水分。如果你搵緊一支遮瑕高、感覺輕盈、妝感完美嘅氣墊，呢個係好好嘅選擇！

reviews.text: Want sure what to expect. This is my first cushion foundation and I was a little confused by the small pad (how will this cover anything). Well wow! The pad picks up a LOT of product and covers well. I have melasma and this covered it nicely without any additional concealer. At first I thought the color was too light but it blended well. Definitely look at the color options when deciding, it makes a major difference. It’s lasts all day but did start to look a little funky as the day wore on. Overall 8/10.
reviews.zh: 唔知有咩期望。呢個係我第一支氣墊粉底，個粉撲咁細我本來有啲疑惑（點樣遮到嘢）。哇！個粉撲索到好多產品，遮瑕都好好。我有荷爾蒙斑，佢遮得好靚，唔使我額外再用遮瑕。起初我以為個色太淺，但推開之後好自然。揀色嘅時候一定要留意唔同嘅色號，呢個有好大分別。佢全日都 keep 到妝，但去到夜晚尾段就開始有啲怪。整體 8/10。

reviews.text:
I can't believe how in love with this foundation I am
. I am 53yrs old and I am of African American/Caucasian mix. I have gone through countless brands and have never truly found my color match until now. I am so in love with the finish of this as well. It leaves my skin looking completely flawless as if I've aged backwards. I also loved that these were minis so I could buy different colors and not spend a fortune while hunting for the perfect color match. I will keep the other two as concealer as they are too light but I love this makeup and am going to buy the bigger size.
reviews.zh: 我唔敢相信我會咁愛上呢支粉底。我 53 歲，係非裔美國人同白人混血。我試過無數個品牌，一直都搵唔到真正啱我膚色嘅色號，直至而家。佢嘅妝效我都超級鍾意。搽完之後皮膚望落完全無瑕，好似時光倒流咁後生咗。我都好鍾意細裝呢個設計，等我可以買唔同色號，唔使喺搵完美色號嘅過程中使晒錢。其他兩個色號對我嚟講太淺，我會留嚟當遮瑕用，但我真係好愛呢個化妝品，一定會回購大裝。

reviews.text: I got this for me and my mom she uses Shade 24W nd I got 25N. She has mature skin and she says it sits very well on her skin and doesn’t accentuate her fine lines or pores. She does have sun spots and freckles which u can still see through the foundation so I’d say it’s a medium coverage. I have younger skin (im22) and my skin has some acne scars and it covers those pretty well for me. I use sunscreen under bc I don’t think this foundation has sunscreen so take that in mind I love the inclusivity in shades! I got the Clio foundation in the darkest shade and it’s VERY light :( but this foundation had my shade perfectly 😭🙂‍↕️
reviews.zh: 我同媽媽都有買，佢用 24W 色號，我買咗 25N。佢係成熟肌，佢話呢個粉底貼膚好好，唔會突顯佢嘅細紋或者毛孔。佢有曬斑同雀斑，透過粉底都仲睇得到，所以我會話佢係中等遮瑕。我嘅皮膚年輕啲（我 22 歲），有啲暗瘡印，對我嚟講佢遮得幾好。我會喺底層搽防曬，因為我覺得呢支粉底冇防曬，所以呢點要留意。我好鍾意佢嘅色號咁多元化！我買過 Clio 粉底嘅最深色號，個色真係太淺 :( 但呢支粉底就啱啱搵到完美色號 😭🙂‍↕️

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
